investigation_notes.Script Purpose: Checks whether a given path/drive supports NTFS alternate data streams (ADS) by resolving the path, verifying the drive format is NTFS, and testing Add-Content for a 'Stream' parameter.
investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell function verifies if a target path supports NTFS alternate data streams by resolving the path, checking the drive format, and confirming Add-Content exposes a 'Stream' parameter. The script is plaintext and non-obfuscated and appears to be an environment capability check consistent with backup or maintenance tooling. The activity was run by a named service account (backupVeeam) on a Windows Server host, so it is considered low priority because the behavior aligns with expected administrative/backup operations and shows no indicators of malicious obfuscation or anomalous process lineage.
